hypotheses.title: Market Capitalization Decile Neutralized Volume-Shock Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Short-term mean reversion following heavy trading volume is distorted by market capitalization skew: small caps suffer wide bid-ask bounces and high volatility, whereas large caps react stably. Discretizing equities into 10 capitalization deciles using densify(bucket(rank(cap), range='0, 1, 0.1')) and group-neutralizing the volume-scaled 3-day return delta removes size factor dominance, isolating pure institutional liquidity rebalancing.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails during broad momentum runaways where volume breakouts continue trending without mean-reverting.

candidates.rationale: Size-decile neutralized 3-day percentage delta scaled by 60-day volume rank

hypotheses.title: Volatility Decile Neutralized Call IV to Parkinson Volatility Spread
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Implied volatility premiums naturally vary across volatility regimes: high-beta growth stocks command persistent speculative option markups, while low-beta value stocks experience compressed premiums. Discretizing equities into 10 Parkinson volatility deciles using densify(bucket(rank(parkinson_volatility_120), range='0, 1, 0.1')) and neutralizing the IV/Parkinson volatility ratio eliminates macro volatility clustering, capturing true contract mispricing across peers.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when realized volatility violently surpasses implied volatility across all equities in market-wide panic.

candidates.rationale: Volatility-decile neutralized 720-day Call IV / 120-day Parkinson Volatility ratio with 120-day backfill

hypotheses.title: Trading Liquidity Decile Neutralized Fundamental Factor Acceleration
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Multi-factor fundamental acceleration reflects revisions in earnings and operational momentum. This information diffuses at different velocities across liquidity tiers: mega-volume equities price revisions rapidly, whereas medium-volume names demonstrate persistent multi-week drift. Neutralizing multi-factor acceleration scores across 10 20-day volume deciles ensures signal weights are balanced evenly across liquidity regimes.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when analyst revision acceleration reverses abruptly due to macro revisions.

candidates.rationale: Liquidity-decile neutralized multi-factor fundamental acceleration score
